result.question: What does the old prophet do after hearing men?

readings.answer: He says it was the man of God who disobeyed the LORD’s command.
readings.support: he said, “It is the man of God who disobeyed the command of the LORD.

readings.answer: He instructs his sons to saddle the donkey.
readings.support: Then the old prophet instructed his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.”

readings.answer: He goes and finds the body lying in the road.
readings.support: and he went and found the body lying in the road

assessments.reason: Verse 13:26 shows his immediate reaction after hearing: “When … heard this, he said, ‘It is the man of God…’” Though the key targets his subsequent actions, this statement is still something he does after hearing.
Verse 13:27 says, “Then the old prophet instructed his sons, ‘Saddle the donkey for me.’” This matches one part of the keyed answer.
Verse 13:28 says, “and he went and found the body lying in the road,” which is the other part of the keyed answer.
